method: Native source pixels premultiplied by alpha, then each2x2 texel block averaged as ideal level1 mipmap. Each individual sprite mip1 converted to8-bit RGBA and composited at exact logical roots. Compare against full native3 premultiplied2x2 mip1. No wider Pillow minification kernel.0..255 units; unquantized native mean retained for stats, so≤.5 alpha error is quantization.
